query: what request-per-minute threshold triggered rate limiting for the enterprise tier client?
notes: rpm_limit=1200 sits on one of seven near-identical `service=ratelimit ... config applied rpm_limit=N` lines (six other tiers, one repeated value) plus a same-vocabulary `tier=enterprise` cache-hit decoy that carries no rpm_limit at all; at a ~10% budget only bm25 (query shares 'tier'/'enterprise') keeps the right line, while recency, frequency, and llmlingua_style are misled by the six other tier lines' identical shape and drop it. The req-id and deploy-hash atoms sit on their own lines and are force-kept regardless of selector.
